prose: Rob Edward invited me onto the Dig Within Podcast for a wide-ranging conversation about the InnerVerse, Vibe Rant and the Marvelous Demystifiers, including how symbolic literacy changes the way we watch Marvel films, Stranger Things and Everything Everywhere All at Once. We also dug into biofield tuning, the ether and what love might really mean.
